source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: renewal of the partnership with HUNA, enabling the company to continue as the Official Sponsor of Al Wasl Club and the first football team
source.note: The HUNA wordmark is across the chest of the yellow home shirt in the club's official player headshots (25 Aug 2026) and in match photos (e.g. vs Al Qadsiah, 13 Sep 2026) on alwaslsc.ae.

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: it will continue as the Platinum Sponsor of the first football team for the fifth consecutive season
source.note: Match photos on alwaslsc.ae (e.g. Al Wasl 5-0 Khorfakkan, 4 Sep 2026) show the 'DUBAI REAL ESTATE CENTRE' logo beneath the shirt number on the back.

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: the Commercial Bank of Dubai logo will appear on the shoulders of the first football team's jerseys during the new season
source.note: The 'CBD' logo is visible on the sleeves of the 2026/27 playing kit in match photos on alwaslsc.ae (e.g. vs Al Ain in the ADIB Cup, 19 Sep 2026).

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: renewed its partnership with Tadawi Healthcare Group, which continues its sponsorship of the club for the sixth consecutive year
source.note: Match photos on alwaslsc.ae (e.g. vs Khorfakkan, 4 Sep 2026, and vs United FC, 16 Aug 2026) show the 'TADAWI' logo on the front of the shorts.

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: Official Infrastructure and Development Partner as well as the Official Training Kit Sponsor of the first football team
source.note: Three-season Namat Development agreement; training-kit sponsor, not on the match shirt.

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: the Car Fare logo will appear on the first team's training kits
source.note: Official Mobility Partner of the first football team; training kits only.

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: a new partnership with Dubai Investments, which becomes the Gold Sponsor of the first football team
source.note: The announcement says the company's logo 'will appear on the jerseys' of first-team players, but no Dubai Investments logo is visible on the 2026/27 home shirt in the club's headshots or the match photos reviewed; exact placement unconfirmed.

source.name: Al Wasl FC: 'Al Wasl Announces the Largest Sponsorship Portfolio in Its History'
source.quote: renewal of its partnership with global sportswear company Puma for the second consecutive season
source.note: Kit maker; Puma logo on the right chest and shorts of the home kit in the club's photos.

summary: Puma 2026/27 home kit. HUNA wordmark across the chest; Dubai Real Estate Centre beneath the back number; CBD on the sleeves; Tadawi on the shorts (club announcement of 26 Jul 2026 plus the club's headshots and match photos of Aug-Sep 2026). Namat and Car Fare sponsor the training kit; Puma makes the kit. Dubai Investments is announced as Gold Sponsor with its logo 'on the jerseys', but its placement on the home shirt is not visible in the photos reviewed, so the list is not confirmed complete.
